column1: # The first farm canary: one run of hostkeeper on one Linux node of the lab, node-5, with the
# coordinator in a container on the lab's development machine and the daemon and coordinator at
# the same release. Each run below was done once. Times are differences between stamps of the
# coordinator's audit file, the daemon's journal, the operator's own commands and an ssh poll of
# the hello service (its readiness and version routes). A time that ends at a poll is an upper
# bound: the event happened at most one poll interval earlier.

column5: adopt and bootstrap apply on the operator's machine, start to end: record the host, stop the old updater, install the package, write the config, start the daemon, leave it pending enrollment

audit enroll_requested to audit enroll_approve, both whole seconds: the operator's time, not hostkeeper's
